The '''HoloNet transceiver''', sometimes referred to as a '''holopod''',<ref name="I">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Introduction|book=The Kathol Rift}}</ref> was a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] communications device. A vareity produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] was called the '''hologram projection pod'''.

==Design==
This round device measured three meters in diameter, with a central holoprojector set into a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] pod. Scanning and projection panels were located around the perimeter of the central projector, which could create an image many meters in height. A control panel was located on the side of the pod, along with cooling vents and a field limiter. The SoroSuub projection pod, like all other [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceivers, could receive and decode HoloNet transmissions sent along [[Simu-tunnel/Legends|S-thread]] channels from anywhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Because of the widespread implementation of the HoloNet, the projection pod had an effective range that spanned the entire galactic disc.

==History and usage==
SoroSuub projection pods were commonly installed on the bridges of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and one was also found in the [[holoprojection chamber]] aboard [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Vader used this to communicate with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to report on the progress of the war.<ref name="RS III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> During the [[Virgillian Civil War]], the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] installed a HoloNet transceiver in the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruiser]] ''[[Flurry]]'' which they had stolen from a captured Imperial vessel.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> This was unusual enough that [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Imperial fleet at [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] noted that it was probably stolen.<ref name="Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>
